name: Warlock
description: Warlocks seek hidden knowledge and supernatural power through binding pacts with mysterious patrons. Their bargains grant strange invocations and a compact reserve of potent magic that returns after a short rest.

subclasses.name: Archfey Patron
subclasses.description: Draw beguiling magic and uncanny mobility from a powerful lord of the Feywild.

grants.name: Archfey Spells
grants.description: Always have Faerie Fire, Sleep, Calm Emotions, Misty Step, Blink, Plant Growth, Dominate Beast, Greater Invisibility, Dominate Person, and Seeming prepared as you reach the Warlock levels that can cast them.

grants.name: Steps of the Fey
grants.description: Misty Step is always prepared and can be cast without a slot a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest. Whenever you cast it, choose Refreshing Step (you or a creature within 10 feet gains 1d10 temporary hit points) or Taunting Step (creatures near the space you left must save or have disadvantage attacking anyone but you until your next turn).

grants.name: Misty Escape
grants.description: When you take damage, use your reaction to cast Misty Step without a slot. Your Steps of the Fey also gains Disappearing Step (become Invisible until your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or cast a spell) and Dreadful Step (nearby creatures at your destination take Psychic damage on a failed Wisdom save).

grants.name: Beguiling Defenses
grants.description: You are immune to the Charmed condition. When a creature tries to charm you, you can use your reaction to turn the effect back on it.

grants.name: Bewitching Magic
grants.description: Immediately after casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with an action and a spell slot, cast Misty Step as part of the same action without spending another slot.

subclasses.name: Celestial Patron
subclasses.description: Channel the radiant power of a mighty being from the Upper Planes to heal allies and punish foes.

grants.name: Celestial Spells
grants.description: Always have Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Daylight, Revivify, Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire, Greater Restoration, and Summon Celestial prepared as you reach the Warlock levels that can cast them.

grants.name: Healing Light
grants.description: Gain a pool of d6s equal to 1 plus your Warlock level. As a bonus action, spend dice up to your Charisma modifier to heal a creature you can see within 60 feet; regain all dice on a long rest.

grants.name: Radiant Soul
grants.description: Gain resistance to Radiant damage. Once per turn when one of your spells deals Radiant or Fire damage, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll against one target.

grants.name: Celestial Resilience
grants.description: After a short or long rest, you and up to five creatures gain temporary hit points; yours equal your Warlock level plus Charisma modifier, and each ally gains half your Warlock level plus Charisma modifier.

grants.name: Searing Vengeance
grants.description: At the start of your turn while making death saves, regain half your hit points, stand up, and deal Radiant damage while blinding nearby creatures. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Fiend Patron
subclasses.description: Draw destructive magic and ruthless resilience from a bargain with a power of the Lower Planes.

grants.name: Fiend Spells
grants.description: Always have Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion, Fireball, Stinking Cloud, Fire Shield, Wall of Fire, Geas, and Insect Plague prepared as you reach the Warlock levels that can cast them.

grants.name: Dark One's Blessing
grants.description: When an enemy drops to 0 hit points within 10 feet of you, gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level.

grants.name: Dark One's Own Luck
grants.description: When you make an ability check or saving throw, add 1d10 after seeing the roll but before its outcome. Uses equal your Charisma modifier per long rest.

grants.name: Fiendish Resilience
grants.description: Choose one damage type except Force whenever you finish a short or long rest; you resist that damage until you choose again.

grants.name: Hurl Through Hell
grants.description: Once per turn when you hit with an attack, banish the target through a nightmare realm until the end of your next turn, when it takes 8d10 Psychic damage. Once per long rest unless you spend a Pact Magic slot to restore it.

subclasses.name: Great Old One Patron
subclasses.description: Touch an alien consciousness beyond reality and wield telepathy, psychic magic, and warped perception.

grants.name: Great Old One Spells
grants.description: Always have Dissonant Whispers, Tasha's Hideous Laughter, Detect Thoughts, Phantasmal Force, Clairvoyance, Hunger of Hadar, Confusion, Summon Aberration, Modify Memory, and Telekinesis prepared as you reach the Warlock levels that can cast them.

grants.name: Awakened Mind
grants.description: Form a telepathic link with a creature you can see within 30 feet. You can communicate while within miles equal to your Charisma modifier, and maintain one link at a time.

grants.name: Psychic Spells
grants.description: When a Warlock spell deals damage, you can change it to Psychic damage. Enchantment and Illusion Warlock spells can be cast without Verbal or Somatic components.

grants.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
grants.description: When you form an Awakened Mind bond, force that creature to make a Wisdom save. On a failure, it has disadvantage attacking you and you have advantage attacking it for the bond's duration. Once per short or long rest.

grants.name: Eldritch Hex
grants.description: Hex is always prepared. A target affected by your Hex also has disadvantage on saving throws using the ability you chose for the spell.

grants.name: Thought Shield
grants.description: Your thoughts cannot be read against your will, and you gain resistance to Psychic damage. When a creature deals Psychic damage to you, it takes the same amount.

grants.name: Create Thrall
grants.description: Summon Aberration is always prepared and can be cast once without material components or a spell slot per long rest. The summoned aberration gains temporary hit points equal to your Warlock level and deals extra Psychic damage on its first hit each turn.

grants.name: Skill Proficiencies
grants.description: Choose 2 skills from the Warlock list.

grants.name: Eldritch Invocations
grants.description: Choose supernatural gifts from your forbidden studies. The total grows with your Warlock level; whenever you gain a Warlock level, you may replace an invocation for which you still qualify.

options.name: Agonizing Blast
options.description: Choose a damaging Warlock cantrip; add your Charisma modifier to its damage rolls.

options.name: Armor of Shadows
options.description: Cast Mage Armor on yourself without spending a spell slot.

options.name: Ascendant Step
options.description: Cast Levitate on yourself without spending a spell slot.

options.name: Devil's Sight
options.description: See normally in Dim Light and Darkness, magical or nonmagical, to 120 feet.

options.name: Devouring Blade
options.description: Attack three times with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.

options.name: Eldritch Mind
options.description: Gain advantage on Constitution saves made to maintain Concentration.

options.name: Eldritch Smite
options.description: Once per turn on a pact-weapon hit, spend a Pact Magic slot for extra Force damage and knock a Huge or smaller target Prone.

options.name: Eldritch Spear
options.description: Choose a damaging Warlock cantrip; its range increases by a number of feet equal to 30 times your Warlock level.

options.name: Fiendish Vigor
options.description: Cast False Life on yourself without a slot and take the maximum roll for its temporary hit points.

options.name: Gaze of Two Minds
options.description: Touch a willing creature to perceive through its senses; maintain the connection at range and cast spells from its space.

options.name: Gift of the Depths
options.description: Breathe underwater, gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and cast Water Breathing once per long rest.

options.name: Gift of the Protectors
options.description: Your Book of Shadows can hold protective names; once per long rest, a named creature that would drop to 0 hit points drops to 1 instead.

options.name: Investment of the Chain Master
options.description: Empower your familiar with flight or swimming, your spell-save DC, magical damage, bonus-action attacks, and damage resistance.

options.name: Lessons of the First Ones
options.description: Gain an Origin feat for which you qualify. This invocation can be selected more than once.

options.name: Lifedrinker
options.description: Once per turn, a pact-weapon hit deals an extra 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage; expend a Hit Point Die to heal yourself.

options.name: Mask of Many Faces
options.description: Cast Disguise Self without spending a spell slot.

options.name: Master of Myriad Forms
options.description: Cast Alter Self without spending a spell slot.

options.name: Misty Visions
options.description: Cast Silent Image without spending a spell slot.

options.name: One with Shadows
options.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, cast Invisibility on yourself without a slot.

options.name: Otherworldly Leap
options.description: Cast Jump on yourself without spending a spell slot.

options.name: Pact of the Blade
options.description: Conjure or bond with a pact weapon, use Charisma for its attacks and damage, and change its damage type to Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant.

options.name: Pact of the Chain
options.description: Learn Find Familiar and cast it as a Magic action without a slot, gaining additional special familiar forms.

options.name: Pact of the Tome
options.description: Conjure a Book of Shadows after a rest; choose three cantrips and two level-1 ritual spells from any class while the book is with you.

options.name: Repelling Blast
options.description: Once per turn when a damaging Warlock cantrip hits a Large or smaller creature, push it up to 10 feet away.

options.name: Thirsting Blade
options.description: Attack twice with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.

options.name: Visions of Distant Realms
options.description: Cast Arcane Eye without spending a spell slot.

options.name: Whispers of the Grave
options.description: Cast Speak with Dead without spending a spell slot.

options.name: Witch Sight
options.description: Gain Truesight to 30 feet.

grants.name: Pact Magic
grants.description: Cast prepared Warlock spells with Charisma. All Pact Magic slots have the same level and return when you finish a short or long rest; an Arcane Focus can serve as your spellcasting focus.

grants.name: Magical Cunning
grants.description: Perform a 1-minute rite to regain expended Pact Magic slots up to half your maximum, rounded up. Once per long rest.

grants.name: Warlock Subclass
grants.description: Choose a patron, gaining features from it at this level and again at later levels.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Warlock Subclass Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen patron.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Contact Patron
grants.description: Cast Contact Other Plane to contact your patron without spending a slot; you automatically succeed on the spell's saving throw. Once per long rest.

grants.name: Warlock Subclass Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen patron.

grants.name: Mystic Arcanum (Level 6 Spell)
grants.description: Choose one level 6 Warlock spell. Cast it once without a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Mystic Arcanum (Level 7 Spell)
grants.description: Choose one level 7 Warlock spell. Cast it once without a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest.

grants.name: Warlock Subclass Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen patron.

grants.name: Mystic Arcanum (Level 8 Spell)
grants.description: Choose one level 8 Warlock spell. Cast it once without a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Mystic Arcanum (Level 9 Spell)
grants.description: Choose one level 9 Warlock spell. Cast it once without a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest.

grants.name: Epic Boon
grants.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat, gaining its benefits.

grants.name: Eldritch Master
grants.description: Whenever you use Magical Cunning, regain all expended Pact Magic slots instead of only half.
